# Feature: Ice block — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #82 (Ice block) from Blocks before it is used in real levels. Effect: slides until it hits a wall. Unique: a pushed block that travels the whole slide in one push. Useful: places a block far away without walking beside it. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** slides until it hits a wall.

**So that** places a block far away without walking beside it.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Ice block for the first time in its teaching room (mech-82-ice-block-room). Teaching moment: First room: an ice block on ice with an orb lane beside its slide line. A player who pushes it toward the nearest wall watches it slide the whole way past the lane and stop somewhere useless, so they restart and learn that an ice block only stops where a braking wall has been arranged. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Push it and it slides in the push direction over floor and ice until a wall, lock, gate or block stops it
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Fire tile: it slides in, melts, and is consumed; that fire tile becomes scorched floor
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Lava tile: it slides in, melts, and is destroyed; the lava tile stays lava
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Shallow water: it stops there and becomes an ice bridge (50)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Deep water: it sinks, melts, and is destroyed; no bridge forms and the water stays
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Void: it falls and is destroyed; the void stays

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Push it and it slides in the push direction over floor and ice until a wall, lock, gate or block stops it
- Fire tile: it slides in, melts, and is consumed; that fire tile becomes scorched floor
- Lava tile: it slides in, melts, and is destroyed; the lava tile stays lava
- Deep water: it sinks, melts, and is destroyed; no bridge forms and the water stays
- Void: it falls and is destroyed; the void stays
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Ice block's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.
